status: read-only source map; no implementation or numerical validation by this agent

steps: Initialize timers, reset settings/defaults; resolve total parameter columns and runtime batch width; reject invalid matrix/batch shapes before full allocation.
Initialize err_info; set soil references; read model/stats/configuration namelists, enforce existing supported-feature gates, allocate per-column input constants and tolerances.
Read grids; initialize microphysics and radiation settings; construct configurable flags and physics grid; allocate runtime fields and 1-column initial profiles.
Prepare fixed dycore/output grid if enabled; apply optional tuner flag override; determine time range and restart input owner.
Read sounding once through initialize_clubb into initial profiles; initialize radiation arrays, stats file/registry and optional SILHS output; check all existing fatal paths.
Initialize PDF, implicit coefficient and precipitation structures; calculate derived parameters.
Native enter data(copyin constants, grids, initial profiles; create evolving outputs), with separate scalar/eddy/hydrometeor clauses; reset first runtime state.
Start timer; reset stats sampling state first. Validate optional batch index; select next stats output batch for batch>1.
Validate replacement parameter matrix shape or copy selected stored batch into active clubb_params. Do not overwrite newly supplied host parameters from stale device data.
Reset radiation state; reset host-only microphysics state Ncm_mc/wpNcp/Nccnm/Ncm/Nc_in_cloud.
Initialize SILHS unused sentinels and every Native reset field in source order on thermodynamic/momentum/surface grids; conditional passive/eddy/hydrometeor groups.
Zero PDF/implicit/precipitation data and initialize hydrometeor PDF fields; handle normal vs restart time, restart fields and inverse densities.

Refresh derived parameters from current parameters/grid/deltaz; debug settings validation may return fatal. Native explicit update device refreshes parameters/lmin/mixture limit and six vertical viscosities.
Resolve stats enabled/suppression and optional time-window endpoints; start outer timer.
For each iteration begin stats only under l_stats. Native input-fields branch is excluded in C++ init; retain current gate.
Debug>=2 invalid_model_arrays check; fatal branch preserves timer stop and ends whole loop.
Calculate thvm; prescribe forcing; debug>=0 fatal exit.
Combine prior microphysical/radiative tendencies into forcing and zero total ice; sum ice hydrometeors in iiri,iirs,iirg order.
Optional radiative thlp2 forcing; advance core; debug>=0 fatal exit. Native descending-grid test remains excluded.
Compute radiation cadence (first timestep or dt_rad interval); conditional PDF preparation/SILHS; debug>=0 fatal exit.
If active microphysics: host scheme tendencies then device-capable advance_microphys; debug>=0 per-column fatal messages/exit. Else optional cloud sedimentation; sampled Ncm update.
Sample total microphysical tendencies; optional radiation/soil scheme, retaining prior radht between radiation timesteps and fatal exit.
Native time-adaptive-grid density/adaptation/write blocks remain excluded. Fixed dycore sampled stats_update_grid remains active.
End/flush stats only under l_stats; fatal exit; update time only after successful timestep; optional iteration output.
Start cleanup timer; Native exit data delete balances base and optional enters before host resource cleanup.
Finalize stats/files; release optional sponge, forcing input, extended atmosphere, grid, radiation, microphysics, restart input and SILHS state in source order.
Release every runtime/initial/parameter allocation; reset column/batch dimensions to one; stop cleanup timer; finalize timing output file.
